28.11.41. 26A
FROM: X

In reply to your memo of 27th November containing extracts from J.Q., we should like J.Q. to have the following reply:-

2. The question of [redacted] has now been settled and J.Q. will have been reassured by our last telegram on the subject.

X/6/116

UNEXPECTED
DEFINITE DECISION REGARDING TRIP
LATER BY PERSONAL LETTER TO ROBERT.
TRIP UNDESIRABLE. TRY TO INFLUENCE
ONLY REPEAT ONLY ON ABSOLUTE
DOES NOT KNOW OF OUR ACTION.
LISBON NOT BE ARRANGED? ROBERT IS
REPLY URGENTLY.
